purpose: User-cycle sampling of the reproducible c3 regression using unchanged plugins; includes warmup/data startup and profiler overhead.
limitations: No resampling; profile timings are not acceptance measurements.
User-cycle sampling cannot measure sleeping/barrier wall time or directly measure kernel fault costs.
Stata proprietary symbols appear as addresses.
Compiler inlining differs: absence of an incumbent read_block symbol is not absence of its work.
Inclusive wait_until_cold includes work executed beneath the scheduler; its percentage must not be interpreted as time spent idle or spinning.
Percentages are rounded and normalized per process; small differences are uncertain.
